Hose Warehouse Test 03: Product Page Stamp

Two static badges, "Full Manufacturer Specs" and "Exact Part Numbers", added to the top-right corner of the product image on every /products/ page. The client confirmed the copy is the same on all product pages.

Control · var 1000257788
Variation · var 1000257789 · cre-t-03
Tested in · Chrome desktop, 1536px
Tester · Sarthak, Brillmark QA
VerdictBugsPagesChecksWireframe vs liveScreenshotsCoverage

Works on desktop. Fix placement and tick color before launch.

The badges render with the right copy, colors and font on 5 of 6 product pages. They stay through variant and image changes, don't block image clicks, and only appear on product pages. Two things don't match the wireframe. The badges are pinned to the square gallery box rather than the photo, so on non-square photos they float in white space. Both ticks also share one dark-blue color. Mobile and other browsers were not run because Cloudflare blocks automated browsers.

17 pass2 warning1 fail2 not run or question

Bugs and questions

BUG-01 · Medium

Badges sit outside the photo on non-square images

Where
P1, P2, P6, and any non-square photo (most of the catalog)
Actual
Badges are positioned inside .product-gallery__viewer, which is square. Photos use object-fit: scale-down. Wide photos (P2 1178×1038, P6 1536×1071) start about 65px lower, and narrow ones (P1, 350px wide in a 695px box) are centered. The badges land in the white margin above or beside the photo.
Expected
The wireframe shows both badges inside the photo's top-right corner.
Fix idea
Anchor the badges to the active slide's image box, or ask the client whether the gallery corner is acceptable.
BUG-02 · Low

Both tick icons are #0b4f8a

Where
vB.js:10, one tick SVG with a fixed stroke color used for both badges
Expected
Each tick matches its badge text: blue #0232cc on badge 1, teal #06739a on badge 2.
Fix
Use stroke="currentColor" in the SVG.
BUG-03 · Low

Both badges share one border color

Where
vB.css:23, border: 1px solid #cfe6f7 on both badges
Expected
Badge 1 has a light blue-lilac border to match its #eaf0ff fill; badge 2 has a light cyan one.
Q-01 · Client

Should the badges appear in the fullscreen lightbox?

Now
Clicking the image opens the lightbox, which has no badges. The brief says "each PDP image", so this is probably fine, but it needs a yes or no.
Note · QA setup

A convert_optout cookie hides every variation

Seen
One Chrome profile had convert_optout=1 on hosewarehouse.com, so the variation link looked exactly like control. Delete that cookie before QA.
Also
The code that re-adds badges after a gallery redraw is commented out (vB.js:46). It isn't needed today, since badges survived variant and slide changes.

Wireframe vs live

Screenshots

Coverage and open items

  • Cloudflare: hosewarehouse.com shows a bot check to curl and headless Playwright, so the usual 7-browser Playwright run could not happen. Testing used a real Chrome profile.
  • Mobile not run: the Chrome window could not be resized below 1536px, and the site refuses to load in an iframe. From the code, the 749px-and-below rules use an 8px inset, 10px font and 3px 6px padding.
  • Browsers not run: Edge, Firefox, Safari, real iOS and Android. The client needs to allowlist our IP or skip the Cloudflare check for cro_mode=qa.
  • Goals: purchase, revenue, cart and checkout goals were not exercised. No orders were placed.
